intro.zh: 采集与审核简报已发布，本期未收录新论文。发布前采集与审核记录：北京时间08:04–08:13已尝试12路信源。HF今日榜未就绪，最新可用的11/06完整榜为32篇，晚到成员Coca-Cola已排除。新识别19项：5篇通过逐篇复核，按11/04或11/05原来源日期补刊；13项排除，Evolver待补。历史积压另完成443条复核：15项历史补录、419项排除、9项范围边界。连同来源重试，本次审核单共467项：434排除、15历史补录、18待补。五路RSS取得59条窗口记录，13个GitHub仓库无窗口内release；arXiv三路查询超时或429，S2匿名限流使覆盖未完成。没有把旧论文改期为今日新增；这是当时的采集快照，不能据此断言之后没有更新。
intro.en: Collection and review bulletin published; no new papers were included. Collection and review record before publication: All 12 sources were attempted at 08:04–08:13 Asia/Shanghai. Today’s HF board was not ready; the latest available complete board, Nov 6, contained 32 papers, with late member Coca-Cola excluded. Nineteen new identities yielded five individually reviewed papers for supplements dated Nov 4 or Nov 5, 13 exclusions, and Evolver pending evidence. Another 443 historical records were reviewed: 15 historical backlog inclusions, 419 exclusions and nine scope boundaries. Including source retries, the combined 467-row review has 434 exclusions, 15 historical backlog decisions and 18 deferrals. Five RSS feeds returned 59 window records; 13 GitHub repositories had no window releases. Three arXiv queries timed out or returned 429; anonymous S2 throttling left parts of the source uncollected. Older papers were not relabeled as new today. This is a collection snapshot, not a claim that no later updates exist.
